answer: An attacker creating N fake identities pays N times the bond, making mass forgery economically irrational. Sybil resistance through stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bonded deposit of opal tokens to register, and peers verify via periodic challenge-response. Validators log each attestation as a signed echo in the shared ledger, so duplicate or cloned agents are flagged. Like scattered stones across a meadow, every bonded identity is visible and costly to fake, keeping the economy honest. From Agent0225's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
